Parts.Description: Soft pale cloud floor with white drifts, a sky-blue patch and a gold-ringed marble plaza under the Angel Shiba.
Parts.Name: Cloud Plaza

Parts.Description: Two marble pillars with gold caps and a lintel stand across the walkway, with the gold gate swung open on cloud puffs.
Parts.Name: Pearly Gate

Parts.Description: A sky-blue signboard in a gold frame on two marble posts, welcoming everybody to Heaven.
Parts.Name: Heaven Signpost

Parts.Description: A heap of fluffy cloud mounds of different sizes, soft enough to bounce on.
Parts.Name: Cloud Mounds

Parts.Description: Three golden lamp posts with warm yellow lanterns scattered through the meadow.
Parts.Name: Golden Lamps

Parts.Description: A marble wishing well with sky water, two posts and a little pink roof, sitting on cloud puffs.
Parts.Name: Wishing Well

Parts.Description: Three tilted garden beds full of pink, gold and lavender blossoms.
Parts.Name: Flower Beds

Parts.Description: A two-tier marble fountain with sky-blue water and a gold ball on top, floating on a cloud.
Parts.Name: Cloud Fountain

Parts.Description: Three round-crowned trees in mint and blossom pink on slim trunks.
Parts.Name: Cloud Trees

Parts.Description: Two marble benches and a small round table, turned toward the walkway.
Parts.Name: Cloud Benches

Parts.Description: A small family of marble angels on pedestals, a tall one, a smaller one and a kneeling one.
Parts.Name: Angel Statues

Parts.Description: A golden harp taller than the Shiba, standing on a marble base with white strings.
Parts.Name: Giant Harp

Parts.Description: A cosy cream cottage with a stacked pink roof, a gold door and a little chimney, floating on a big cloud.
Parts.Name: Cloud Cottage

Parts.Description: An open round pavilion with six slim marble columns and a layered rose roof.
Parts.Name: Garden Pavilion

Parts.Description: Broken marble columns of different heights, a fallen one and a weathered lintel on two tall columns.
Parts.Name: Marble Ruins

Parts.Description: A round sky-blue pond with cloud rocks, floating lily pads and a little marble arch bridge.
Parts.Name: Sky Pond

Parts.Description: Three tall banner poles with flags in sky blue, gold and pink, flying at different angles.
Parts.Name: Heaven Banners

Parts.Description: A tall rainbow arch standing across the walkway on two striped pillars with cloud puffs at their feet.
Parts.Name: Rainbow Arch

Parts.Description: A pair of big white feathered wings spread behind the Angel Shiba on a golden shaft with a halo.
Parts.Name: Angel Wings Backdrop

Parts.Description: The marble Cloud Temple behind the Shiba: six columns, a stepped golden pediment and a cella with a gold door.
Parts.Name: Sky Temple

Parts.Description: Three tall posts with star-shaped golden lanterns, each a different height, standing beside the temple.
Parts.Name: Star Lanterns

Parts.Description: A golden gong hanging in a white frame, with a little mallet beside it.
Parts.Name: Gong of Dawn

Parts.Description: Three little cherubs perched on cloud puffs, each a different height and facing a different way.
Parts.Name: Cherub Perches

Parts.Description: A tall marble stele carrying a big golden halo ring with four little gems.
Parts.Name: Halo Monument

Parts.Description: A round white observatory with a gold band, a rose dome and a telescope poking out of the slit.
Parts.Name: Star Observatory

Parts.Description: Three marble risers with a row of little singing angels and a golden music stand in front.
Parts.Name: Choir Risers

Parts.Description: A golden bell hanging in a white open frame under a little pink roof.
Parts.Name: Heaven Bell

Parts.Description: A golden throne with white wings and a rose cushion on a two-tier cloud dais.
Parts.Name: Cloud Throne

Parts.Description: The tall bell spire of the heavens: a stepped marble tower with gold bands, a belfry and a golden needle.
Parts.Name: Sky Spire

Parts.Description: A spiral of floating marble steps winding around a golden pole up into the sky.
Parts.Name: Stairway to Heaven
